critique: The artwork demonstrates striking boldness through its tactile Dadaist composition, utilizing sliding primary-colored gradient bands and a procedurally animated canvas weave to successfully subvert static web layouts. Replacing the broken external image assets (`portrait.png`, `guineapig.png`) with generative organic forms—such as blooming code-vines or bioluminescent data-threads—would elevate the piece by seamlessly integrating much-needed cyber-nature fusion.
